subject: general
question: Sanskrit language is mainly used for creating:
solution:
The correct answer is __**ancient religious texts and epics**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sanskrit language is primarily associated with the composition of **ancient religious texts, epics, and philosophical works**.
 
• Key scriptures such as the **Vedas, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita**, and the **Puranas** are written in Sanskrit.
 
• Sanskrit is considered the **mother of many Indo-Aryan languages** and holds a significant place in Indian culture and heritage.
 
• Epics like the **Mahabharata** and **Ramayana**, which are pivotal to Indian mythology, were originally composed in Sanskrit.
 
• The language is revered as **Devabhasha**, meaning 'language of the gods,' in Hindu tradition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vedas:**

 
 
• The Vedas are the oldest sacred texts of Hinduism, consisting of four collections: Rigveda, Yajurveda, Samaveda, and Atharvaveda.
 
• They contain hymns, rituals, philosophies, and spiritual knowledge.
 
 
 
• **Upanishads:**
 
 
• These texts are philosophical and spiritual commentaries on the Vedas, exploring concepts like Brahman (ultimate reality) and Atman (soul).
 
• The Upanishads are considered the foundation of Indian philosophy.
 
 
 
• **Mahabharata:**
 
 
• One of the longest epic poems in the world, it narrates the Kurukshetra War and contains profound moral and philosophical teachings.
 
• The **Bhagavad Gita**, a sacred scripture, is part of the Mahabharata.
 
 
 
• **Ramayana:**
 
 
• The Ramayana, attributed to Sage Valmiki, depicts the life and adventures of Lord Rama, including the rescue of Sita from Ravana.
 
• It is an epic that emphasizes dharma (duty), devotion, and righteousness.
 
 
 
• **Classical Significance:**
 
 
• Sanskrit is one of the **22 scheduled languages of India** and is recognized as a classical language.
 
• It has contributed significantly to the fields of linguistics, mathematics, and astronomy.
